meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.
meta.coverage: The states' cushions: what each state holds in its consolidated sinking fund, guarantee redemption fund, budget stabilisation fund and Treasury bills with the RBI, month-end, since September 2017
meta.note: RBI Bulletin, Investments by State Governments (DBIE report 37). The sinking fund (CSF), guarantee redemption fund (GRF) and budget stabilisation fund (BSF, from December 2025) are reserve funds kept with the RBI; ATBs are Treasury bills bought at auction (the table's notes 1, 2 and 4). An empty cell is '--', not a member of the scheme: left empty. All-state sums are computed here.
